lines.l: I can't see you, but I know you're there
Got to get beside you, cause it's really cold out here
Come up close to me, you'll soon be warm
Hold me tightly, like we're sheltering from a storm
Think I might go out for a stroll Into the night and out of this hole
Maybe find me a meal Walking along this new shared pile
To sense a problem all the while Nearly the door
Suddenly he bumps into wood, the door is closed
The voice from the bed, he'll be exposed
His way to run was made for the whole
The lights didn't turn on, he's blind as a morning call
Now I can see they're coming at me
They've blocked out my door, I haven't a chance in hell
Come on, baby, let the poor thing go
I'm not sleeping with that thing around, you know
All right then, I'll fetch a box from below
Guard him carefully, they're very quick, you know
The door's been opened, my chance to escape
Must run out quick, better sorry than late
I'm out on the stairs
It won't catch me now, I've been running the house now
I'll make it downstairs and into the red bin
That would be nice
Suddenly he bumps into fire, that's very unwise
The cat is much quicker than men and their eyes
The chase that ensues can have only one end
Unless outside help steps in for our friend in need
But now the cat comes in for the kill
His pour is raised, so blood will spill
Yes, it will
Harlot Mouse, this is the end of your road
The shine force is inside me
Let me bear your heavy love
But it's hard to be that final pounce
Knocks the job on me, says a lazy mouth
But it's all in our houses now
To take on all those who'd find
There I was with my back to the wall
